description: Get a project-scoped expense (Project → Costs → Expenses tab) by ID, including amount, date, receipt, and linked project or work order. Does NOT include invoice_number or po_number - those live on asset_costs (the main AssetLab "Expenses" page). Use get_asset_cost for that record type. Amounts are bare numbers with no currency: call get_organization_settings for currency_code before stating one.
name: get_expense
title: Get expense
